verdict.rationale: Superpowers is a library of skills (markdown instructions plus small helper scripts) that runs inside a third-party coding-agent harness such as Claude Code, Codex or Devin. It has no hosted backend where user data is stored, so choosing a storage region or residency is a category error for this kind of product. Its only working files are a local per-plan workspace inside the repo, which is deleted after review, with git history as the durable record.
